name: NTG Nordic Transport Group A/S
summary: NTG Nordic Transport Group A/S, through its subsidiaries, provides cargo transportation services through truck, ship, and aircraft in Denmark and internationally. The company operates in two divisions, Road & Logistics and Air & Ocean. It offers project transportation, warehousing/logistics, customs, express, and other services, as well as road, air, and sea freight transportation services. The company was formerly known as NeuroSearch A/S and changed its name to NTG Nordic Transport Group A/S in October 2019. NTG Nordic Transport Group A/S was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Hvidovre, Denmark.
